theorems.name: M5Authority.bind_eq_ok
theorems.claim: A bind that returns ok came from an ok computation and an ok continuation.
theorems.statement: @M5Authority.bind_eq_ok : ∀ {α β : Type} {m : Aeneas.Std.Result α} {f : α → Aeneas.Std.Result β} {v : β}, m >>= f = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok v → ∃ a, m = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok a ∧ f a = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok v

theorems.statement: M5Authority.owner_eq : ∀ (a b : noble_kernel.authority.OwnerContext), noble_kernel.authority.OwnerContext.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqOwnerContext.eq a b = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (decide (a = b))

theorems.name: M5Authority.bytes_allM
theorems.claim: Element-wise byte comparison over equal-length lists decides list equality.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.bytes_allM : ∀ (l0 l1 : List Aeneas.Std.U8), l0.length = l1.length → List.allM (fun x => match x with | (x0, x1) => Aeneas.Std.core.cmp.PartialEqU8.eq x0 x1) (l0.zip l1) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (decide (l0 = l1))

theorems.statement: M5Authority.quota_position_matches : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (plan : noble_kernel.authority.Plan), ∃ o, noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.quota_position s plan = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok o ∧ M5Authority.QuotaMatch s plan o

theorems.name: M5Authority.attempt_record_ok
theorems.claim: The attempt lookup accepts exactly an owned, present, same-generation attempt key.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.attempt_record_ok : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (key : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AttemptKey) (record : noble_kernel.authority.AttemptRecord), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.attempt_record s key = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok record) ↔ key.owner = s.profile.owner ∧ (↑s.attempts)[↑key.slot]? = some record ∧ key.generation = record.key.generation

theorems.name: M5Authority.start_execution_refuses_a_started_attempt
theorems.claim: Starting an already-started attempt returns AlreadyStarted and leaves the authority unchanged.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.start_execution_refuses_a_started_attempt : ∀ (self : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution) (record : noble_kernel.authority.AttemptRecord), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.attempt_record self execution.attempt = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok record) → record.started = true → noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.start_execution self execution = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError.AlreadyStarted, self)

theorems.name: M5Authority.start_execution_refusal_returns_input
theorems.claim: Every start refusal returns the unchanged authority.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.start_execution_refusal_returns_input : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution) (error : noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.start_execution self execution = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err error, s') → s' = self

theorems.name: M5Authority.start_execution_marks_one_unstarted_attempt
theorems.claim: A successful start marks exactly the presented unstarted attempt, counts one protected operation and leaves witnesses, quotas and the profile unchanged.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.start_execution_marks_one_unstarted_attempt : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution) (started : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Started), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.start_execution self execution = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok started, s') → ∃ record, noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.attempt_record self execution.attempt = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok record) ∧ record.started = false ∧ ↑s'.attempts = (↑self.attempts).set ↑execution.attempt.slot { key := record.key, plan := record.plan, started := true, admitted := record.admitted, unknown := record.unknown, terminal := record.terminal } ∧ ↑s'.counters.protected_operations = ↑self.counters.protected_operations + 1 ∧ s'.witnesses = self.witnesses ∧ s'.quotas = self.quotas ∧ s'.profile = self.profile ∧ started.attempt = record.key ∧ started.plan = record.plan

theorems.name: M5Authority.started_attempt_cannot_start_again
theorems.claim: Attempts start at most once: replaying the execution permit on the resulting state is refused without change.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.started_attempt_cannot_start_again : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution) (started : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Started), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.start_execution self execution = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok started, s') → noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.start_execution s' execution = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError.AlreadyStarted, s')

theorems.name: M5Authority.witness_record_found
theorems.claim: An accepted witness lookup is owned by the authority and returns the record at the claimed slot.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.witness_record_found : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (claim : noble_kernel.authority.permit.WitnessClaim) (record : noble_kernel.authority.WitnessRecord), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.witness_record s claim = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok record) → claim.owner = s.profile.owner ∧ (↑s.witnesses)[↑claim.slot]? = some record

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_the_presented_claim
theorems.claim: Entry validation accepts only a presented witness whose claim equals the requested claim.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_the_presented_claim : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (available : Aeneas.Std.U64), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.validate_entry s witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok available) → ∃ presented, witness = some presented ∧ presented.claim = request.claim ∧ request.claim.owner = s.profile.owner

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_a_live_witness
theorems.claim: Entry validation accepts only a live retained witness at the claimed slot.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_a_live_witness : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (available : Aeneas.Std.U64), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.validate_entry s witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok available) → ∃ retained, (↑s.witnesses)[↑request.claim.slot]? = some retained ∧ retained.state = noble_kernel.authority.permit.WitnessState.Live

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_the_exact_plan
theorems.claim: Entry validation accepts only a retained witness whose plan equals the requested plan.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_the_exact_plan : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (available : Aeneas.Std.U64), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.validate_entry s witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok available) → ∃ retained, (↑s.witnesses)[↑request.claim.slot]? = some retained ∧ retained.plan = request.plan

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_valid_facts
theorems.claim: Entry validation accepts only validated facts and returns their supplied quota snapshot.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.validate_entry_requires_valid_facts : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (available : Aeneas.Std.U64), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.validate_entry s witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok available) → noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.validate_facts s request.plan current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok ()) ∧ current.quota_remaining = some available

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_facts_requires_the_current_checkpoint
theorems.claim: Fact validation accepts only facts at the authority checkpoint.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.validate_facts_requires_the_current_checkpoint : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (plan : noble_kernel.authority.Plan) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.validate_facts s plan current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok ()) → current.checkpoint = s.profile.checkpoint

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_facts_requires_current_authority
theorems.claim: Fact validation requires a pending invocation, the owner, the authority source, a grant of exactly the plan, valid credentials, no revocation, the plan policy, the validity window and an accepted quota check.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.validate_facts_requires_current_authority : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (plan : noble_kernel.authority.Plan) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.validate_facts s plan current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok ()) → s.invocation = noble_kernel.authority.report.InvocationOutcome.Pending ∧ plan.description.owner = s.profile.owner ∧ current.source = s.profile.authority_source ∧ (∃ grant, current.grant = some grant ∧ grant.plan = plan ∧ grant.kind = s.profile.witness_kind) ∧ current.credentials_valid = some true ∧ current.revoked = some false ∧ current.policy = some plan.description.policy ∧ ↑plan.description.constraints.not_before ≤ ↑current.checkpoint.now ∧ ↑current.checkpoint.now < ↑plan.description.constraints.expires_at ∧ noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.validate_quota s plan current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok ())

theorems.name: M5Authority.validate_quota_bounds_the_charge
theorems.claim: The quota check accepts only a charge within the supplied snapshot; an existing checkpoint-local record must carry that same snapshot.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.validate_quota_bounds_the_charge : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (plan : noble_kernel.authority.Plan) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.validate_quota s plan current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok ()) → ∃ available, current.quota_remaining = some available ∧ ∀ (o : Option Aeneas.Std.Usize), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.quota_position s plan = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok o → match o with | none => ↑plan.description.constraints.units ≤ ↑available | some j => ∃ record, (↑s.quotas)[↑j]? = some record ∧ record.available = available ∧ ↑record.spent + ↑plan.description.constraints.units ≤ ↑available

theorems.name: M5Authority.charge_quota_refusal_returns_input
theorems.claim: A refused quota charge returns the unchanged authority.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.charge_quota_refusal_returns_input : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (plan : noble_kernel.authority.Plan) (available : Aeneas.Std.U64) (denial : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Denial), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.charge_quota self plan available = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err denial, s') → s' = self

theorems.name: M5Authority.commit_refusal_returns_input
theorems.claim: A refused commit returns the unchanged authority.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.commit_refusal_returns_input : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (available : Aeneas.Std.U64) (admitted : Aeneas.Std.U32) (denial : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Denial), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.commit self request available admitted = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err denial, s') → s' = self

theorems.name: M5Authority.refused_admission_preserves_ledger
theorems.claim: Denial and preflight leave witnesses, attempts and quota records unchanged; only their request counter and requested effect move.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.refused_admission_preserves_ledger : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (facts : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (outcome : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request facts = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → (∀ (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), outcome ≠ noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission.Committed execution) → s'.witnesses = self.witnesses ∧ s'.attempts = self.attempts ∧ s'.quotas = self.quotas

theorems.name: M5Authority.push_ok
theorems.claim: A successful modeled Vec push appends exactly the pushed element.
theorems.statement: @M5Authority.push_ok : ∀ {α : Type} {v w : Aeneas.Std.alloc.vec.Vec α} {x : α}, v.push x = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok w → ↑w = ↑v ++ [x]

theorems.name: M5Authority.index_mut_ok
theorems.claim: A successful modeled mutable index reads the indexed element and writes back by replacement at that index.
theorems.statement: @M5Authority.index_mut_ok : ∀ {α : Type} {v : Aeneas.Std.alloc.vec.Vec α} {i : Aeneas.Std.Usize} {x : α} {back : α → Aeneas.Std.alloc.vec.Vec α}, Aeneas.Std.alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (Aeneas.Std.core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice α) v i = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (x, back) → (↑v)[↑i]? = some x ∧ ∀ (y : α), ↑(back y) = (↑v).set (↑i) y

theorems.name: M5Authority.charge_quota_keeps_the_rest
theorems.claim: A successful quota charge changes no field other than the quota records.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.charge_quota_keeps_the_rest : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (plan : noble_kernel.authority.Plan) (available : Aeneas.Std.U64), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.charge_quota s plan available = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (), s') → s'.profile = s.profile ∧ s'.witnesses = s.witnesses ∧ s'.attempts = s.attempts ∧ s'.counters = s.counters ∧ s'.invocation = s.invocation

theorems.name: M5Authority.charge_quota_charges_the_plan_units
theorems.claim: A successful quota charge adds exactly the plan units to the located record, or opens a record for this checkpoint holding the supplied snapshot and exactly those units.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.charge_quota_charges_the_plan_units : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (plan : noble_kernel.authority.Plan) (available : Aeneas.Std.U64), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.charge_quota s plan available = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (), s') → ∀ (o : Option Aeneas.Std.Usize), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.quota_position s plan = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok o → match o with | none => ↑s'.quotas = ↑s.quotas ++ [{ quota := plan.description.constraints.quota, checkpoint := s.profile.checkpoint, available := available, spent := plan.description.constraints.units }] | some j => ∃ record spent, (↑s.quotas)[↑j]? = some record ∧ ↑spent = ↑record.spent + ↑plan.description.constraints.units ∧ ↑s'.quotas = (↑s.quotas).set ↑j { quota := record.quota, checkpoint := record.checkpoint, available := record.available, spent := spent }

theorems.name: M5Authority.commit_consumes_the_claimed_witness
theorems.claim: A successful commit marks exactly the claimed witness slot consumed.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.commit_consumes_the_claimed_witness : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (available : Aeneas.Std.U64) (admitted : Aeneas.Std.U32) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.commit s request available admitted = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok execution, s') → ∃ retained, (↑s.witnesses)[↑request.claim.slot]? = some retained ∧ ↑s'.witnesses = (↑s.witnesses).set ↑request.claim.slot { claim := retained.claim, plan := retained.plan, state := noble_kernel.authority.permit.WitnessState.Consumed }

theorems.name: M5Authority.commit_registers_one_unstarted_attempt
theorems.claim: A successful commit appends exactly one unstarted attempt bound to the requested plan and keyed by the returned permit.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.commit_registers_one_unstarted_attempt : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (available : Aeneas.Std.U64) (admitted : Aeneas.Std.U32) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.commit s request available admitted = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok execution, s') → ↑s'.attempts = ↑s.attempts ++ [{ key := execution.attempt, plan := request.plan, started := false, admitted := s.profile.checkpoint, unknown := none, terminal := none }] ∧ execution.attempt.owner = s.profile.owner ∧ ↑execution.attempt.slot = (↑s.attempts).length

theorems.name: M5Authority.commit_charges_the_plan_quota
theorems.claim: A successful commit applies exactly the quota charge of the requested plan.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.commit_charges_the_plan_quota : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (available : Aeneas.Std.U64) (admitted : Aeneas.Std.U32) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.commit s request available admitted = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok execution, s') → ∀ (o : Option Aeneas.Std.Usize), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.quota_position s request.plan = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok o → match o with | none => ↑s'.quotas = ↑s.quotas ++ [{ quota := request.plan.description.constraints.quota, checkpoint := s.profile.checkpoint, available := available, spent := request.plan.description.constraints.units }] | some j => ∃ record spent, (↑s.quotas)[↑j]? = some record ∧ ↑spent = ↑record.spent + ↑request.plan.description.constraints.units ∧ ↑s'.quotas = (↑s.quotas).set ↑j { quota := record.quota, checkpoint := record.checkpoint, available := record.available, spent := spent }

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_path
theorems.claim: A committed admission validated the entry and committed on the same request-recorded state, whose ledger fields are the caller’s.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.committed_admission_path : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission.Committed execution, s') → ∃ staged available admitted, staged.profile = self.profile ∧ staged.witnesses = self.witnesses ∧ staged.attempts = self.attempts ∧ staged.quotas = self.quotas ∧ staged.invocation = self.invocation ∧ noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.validate_entry staged witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok available) ∧ noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.commit staged request available admitted = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok execution, s')

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_presents_the_claim
theorems.claim: A committed admission required a presented witness carrying exactly the requested, authority-owned claim.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.committed_admission_presents_the_claim : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission.Committed execution, s') → ∃ presented, witness = some presented ∧ presented.claim = request.claim ∧ request.claim.owner = self.profile.owner

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_binds_the_exact_plan
theorems.claim: Admitted execution stays bound to the independently authorized plan: the retained witness and the current grant both carry exactly the requested plan.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.committed_admission_binds_the_exact_plan : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission.Committed execution, s') → (∃ retained, (↑self.witnesses)[↑request.claim.slot]? = some retained ∧ retained.plan = request.plan) ∧ ∃ grant, current.grant = some grant ∧ grant.plan = request.plan

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_requires_the_current_checkpoint
theorems.claim: Stale facts cannot mint an execution permit: committed admission requires facts at the authority checkpoint.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.committed_admission_requires_the_current_checkpoint : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission.Committed execution, s') → current.checkpoint = self.profile.checkpoint

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_requires_current_authority
theorems.claim: Committed admission requires a pending invocation, owner, authority source, valid credentials, no revocation, the plan policy and the validity window.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.committed_admission_requires_current_authority : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission.Committed execution, s') → self.invocation = noble_kernel.authority.report.InvocationOutcome.Pending ∧ request.plan.description.owner = self.profile.owner ∧ current.source = self.profile.authority_source ∧ current.credentials_valid = some true ∧ current.revoked = some false ∧ current.policy = some request.plan.description.policy ∧ ↑request.plan.description.constraints.not_before ≤ ↑current.checkpoint.now ∧ ↑current.checkpoint.now < ↑request.plan.description.constraints.expires_at

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_consumes_one_live_witness
theorems.claim: Each consumed witness corresponds to one admitted attempt: committed admission consumes exactly the claimed, previously live witness.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.committed_admission_consumes_one_live_witness : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission.Committed execution, s') → ∃ retained, (↑self.witnesses)[↑request.claim.slot]? = some retained ∧ retained.state = noble_kernel.authority.permit.WitnessState.Live ∧ ↑s'.witnesses = (↑self.witnesses).set ↑request.claim.slot { claim := retained.claim, plan := retained.plan, state := noble_kernel.authority.permit.WitnessState.Consumed }

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_registers_one_unstarted_attempt
theorems.claim: Committed admission registers exactly one unstarted attempt bound to the requested plan.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.committed_admission_registers_one_unstarted_attempt : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission.Committed execution, s') → ↑s'.attempts = ↑self.attempts ++ [{ key := execution.attempt, plan := request.plan, started := false, admitted := self.profile.checkpoint, unknown := none, terminal := none }] ∧ execution.attempt.owner = self.profile.owner ∧ ↑execution.attempt.slot = (↑self.attempts).length

theorems.name: M5Authority.committed_admission_charges_within_the_supplied_quota
theorems.claim: Committed admission charges exactly the plan units to this checkpoint record for the plan quota, which carries the supplied snapshot, and the charge stays within it.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.committed_admission_charges_within_the_supplied_quota : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission.Committed execution, s') → ∃ available, current.quota_remaining = some available ∧ ((∃ j record spent, (↑self.quotas)[↑j]? = some record ∧ record.quota = request.plan.description.constraints.quota ∧ record.checkpoint = self.profile.checkpoint ∧ record.available = available ∧ ↑spent = ↑record.spent + ↑request.plan.description.constraints.units ∧ ↑spent ≤ ↑available ∧ ↑s'.quotas = (↑self.quotas).set ↑j { quota := record.quota, checkpoint := record.checkpoint, available := record.available, spent := spent }) ∨ ↑request.plan.description.constraints.units ≤ ↑available ∧ ↑s'.quotas = ↑self.quotas ++ [{ quota := request.plan.description.constraints.quota, checkpoint := self.profile.checkpoint, available := available, spent := request.plan.description.constraints.units }])

theorems.name: M5Authority.admission_preserves_quota_within
theorems.claim: Every admission outcome preserves the checkpoint-local quota invariant.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.admission_preserves_quota_within : ∀ (self s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : Option noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (request : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AdmissionRequest) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (outcome : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Admission), M5Authority.QuotaWithin self → noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.admit self witness request current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → M5Authority.QuotaWithin s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.authorize_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Authorization never writes a quota record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.authorize_keeps_quotas : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (plan : noble_kernel.authority.Plan) (current : noble_kernel.authority.CurrentFacts) (outcome : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Authorization), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.authorize_from_trusted_host s plan current = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → s'.quotas = s.quotas

theorems.name: M5Authority.advance_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Checkpoint advancement never writes a quota record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.advance_keeps_quotas : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (checkpoint : noble_kernel.authority.Checkpoint) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result Unit noble_kernel.authority.SetupError), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.advance_from_trusted_host s checkpoint = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → s'.quotas = s.quotas

theorems.name: M5Authority.start_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Execution start never writes a quota record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.start_keeps_quotas : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (execution : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Execution) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result noble_kernel.authority.permit.Started noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError), noble_kernel.authority.admission.Authority.start_execution s execution = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → s'.quotas = s.quotas

theorems.name: M5Authority.observe_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Observation never writes a quota record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.observe_keeps_quotas : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (description : noble_kernel.authority.report.ObservationDescription) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result noble_kernel.authority.report.Observation noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.observe_from_trusted_host s description = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → s'.quotas = s.quotas

theorems.name: M5Authority.retire_witness_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Witness retirement never writes a quota record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.retire_witness_keeps_quotas : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (witness : noble_kernel.authority.permit.Witness) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result Unit noble_kernel.authority.permit.Denial), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.retire_witness s witness = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → s'.quotas = s.quotas

theorems.name: M5Authority.retire_live_witnesses_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: The generated live-witness retirement loop terminates and never writes a quota record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.retire_live_witnesses_keeps_quotas : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.retire_live_witnesses s = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok s' → s'.quotas = s.quotas

theorems.name: M5Authority.cancel_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Invocation cancellation never writes a quota record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.cancel_keeps_quotas : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result noble_kernel.authority.report.InvocationOutcome noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.cancel_invocation s = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → s'.quotas = s.quotas

theorems.claim: Invocation failure never writes a quota record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.fail_keeps_quotas : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result noble_kernel.authority.report.InvocationOutcome noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.fail_invocation s = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → s'.quotas = s.quotas

theorems.name: M5Authority.deliver_keeps_quotas
theorems.claim: Success delivery never writes a quota record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.deliver_keeps_quotas : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority) (attempt : noble_kernel.authority.permit.AttemptKey) (observed : noble_kernel.authority.report.Observation) (outcome : Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result noble_kernel.authority.report.Receipt noble_kernel.authority.report.BoundaryError), noble_kernel.authority.observation.Authority.deliver_success s attempt observed = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (outcome, s') → s'.quotas = s.quotas

theorems.name: M5Authority.new_opens_no_quota
theorems.claim: A newly constructed authority has no quota record.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.new_opens_no_quota : ∀ (profile : noble_kernel.authority.Profile) (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.new profile = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok s) → ↑s.quotas = []

theorems.statement: M5Authority.new_starts_within_quota : ∀ (profile : noble_kernel.authority.Profile) (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), noble_kernel.authority.facts.Authority.new profile = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok s) → M5Authority.QuotaWithin s

theorems.name: M5Authority.step_preserves_quota_within

theorems.statement: M5Authority.step_preserves_quota_within : ∀ (s s' : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), M5Authority.Step s s' → M5Authority.QuotaWithin s → M5Authority.QuotaWithin s'

theorems.name: M5Authority.reachable_quota_within
theorems.claim: Over every finite serialized prefix of public transitions from Authority.new, each checkpoint-local quota record stays within its supplied snapshot.
theorems.statement: M5Authority.reachable_quota_within : ∀ (s : noble_kernel.authority.Authority), M5Authority.Reachable s → M5Authority.QuotaWithin s

mutation_controls.removes: the checkpoint-local quota charge in charge_quota (both the existing-record and the new-record branch)
marking the claimed witness consumed in commit
the retained-witness exact-plan comparison in validate_entry
the facts checkpoint comparison in validate_facts

claims.finite_rust_comparisons: none in this lane; the binding and sequencing Rust controls remain crates/noble-kernel/tests/m5-authority
claims.correspondence: statements name the retained generated functions; Charon/Aeneas translation of the bound sources is trusted, not re-run

assumptions: Pinned Lean and imported Aeneas/Mathlib dependency libraries are trusted; downloaded dependency .oleans are not rebuilt by this audit.
The retained Charon/Aeneas translation is trusted to model the bound Rust sources; this lane does not re-run the translation.
Reachable handwritten external models are part of the trusted base and are listed in binding.external_models.
Checkpoint renewal is a host premise: a fresh checkpoint opens fresh quota records from fresh host snapshots.
non_claims: No cross-checkpoint quota conservation: quota records are checkpoint-local.
No concurrency, crash-recovery, remote-revocation atomicity or exactly-once delivery claim.
No witness/attempt counting invariant over reachable states; consumption and registration are proved per committed admission.
No Rust compiler, Charon or Aeneas correctness claim.
scope: Universal theorems over the retained generated M5 authority transitions: committed-admission guarantees, refusal preservation, attempt start at most once, and the checkpoint-local quota invariant over every finite serialized prefix of public transitions from Authority.new.
